observed_features: low resonant current at gate turn-on
cases.root_cause: Insufficient resonant current at the tested operating point.
verification_steps: Measure IRES and complementary gate timing together.
fix: Review the switching frequency and resonant tank operating point.

cases.root_cause: Gate dead-time evidence is inconsistent with the recorded switching interval.
verification_steps: Measure both gate edges with the same time reference.
fix: Review the configured dead-time against the captured gate waveforms.

observed_features: VDS remains high at gate turn-on
cases.root_cause: VDS remains elevated at the observed gate turn-on event.
verification_steps: Repeat the measurement with probe polarity and scaling documented.
fix: Review the turn-on waveform and acquisition setup with an engineer.

observed_features: high primary current during the loaded interval
cases.root_cause: Primary switch current stress is elevated in the recorded operating condition.
verification_steps: Repeat current and temperature measurements at the stated load.
fix: Review current stress, thermal path, and test condition together.

cases.root_cause: Conduction loss may be associated with the recorded temperature-dependent Rds(on).
verification_steps: Record junction or case temperature and the Rds(on) test condition.
fix: Review datasheet test conditions and thermal measurements.

cases.root_cause: The recorded thermal condition is inconsistent with the intended cooling setup.
verification_steps: Verify airflow, heatsink mounting, and temperature sensor placement.
fix: Correct the cooling test condition before comparing electrical stress.
